Matt Mocarski was a 3D artist who worked Blizzard Entertainment. Mocarski joined Blizzard in the summer of 2001, taking a five-figure paycut from his prior job. He had been hoping to work on a sequel to StarCraft, but was instead assigned to Team 2 to work on World of Warcraft. He was put off by the decrepit conditions of Team 2's office space. However, he enjoyed his time working on the game.

]] Master of the Turbulent Timeways II is a timewalking achievement that is earned by earning a total of four stacks of the Knowledge of Timeways for five weeks of the Turbulent Timeways event in January 2025. The buff lasts for 2 hours and will refresh after every timewalking dungeon cleared. After obtaining four stacks of the buff, it'll change to the Mastery of Timeways buff. The mastery buff can also be refreshed by completing timewalking dungeons. The Mastery of Timeways buff does not need to be earned on the same character each week. The achievement rewards the Timely Buzzbee mount.

Mats Steen (3 July 1989–18 November 2014), also known by his online alias Ibelin, was a Norwegian World of Warcraft player and member of the roleplaying guild Starlight on Argent Dawn EU. He was born with (DMD), a rare neuromuscular disease which causes progressive muscle damage and weakness and which confined him to a wheelchair in his home for much of his life. He found an outlet in online gaming and particularly World of Warcraft, in which he roleplayed mainly as the rogue character Lord Ibelin Redmoore and built a number of close international relationships as a member of the Starlight community. High Executor Mavren is a Forsaken quest giver located at Tranquillien in the Ghostlands. Sylvanas Windrunner appointed him to assist Dame Auriferous in defeating Dar'Khan Drathir because he used to fight the Scourge. Nearly twenty years later, Mavren has long since retired due to the Scourge no longer being a threat in the area. He remains in Tranquillien as Old Man Mavren. Despite being armed, he cowered in fear when the town, and more directly himself, came under attack by the Twilight's Blade and could be rescued during the battle for the town.

McFarlane Toys is a collectible manufacturer known for highly detailed action figures and statues across entertainment and gaming brands. McFarlane Toys formally partnered with Blizzard Entertainment on 7 June 2023, signing a licensing agreement to produce collectible figures for World of Warcraft, Diablo, and Warcraft Arclight Rumble (now Warcraft Rumble). After a year hiatus in 2025, an elite edition Lich King figurine was revealed in early 2026 that also included a redemption code for four in-game transmogs. This ended up being the Arsenal: Golden Crests of the Kingdom, which was originally only available from the Warcraft 30th Anniversary World Tour.

Meeksi are a race of intelligent pandas known for their adventurous nature and love of tea. Adult meeksi are huge, quadrupedal bear-like creatures, also called "tea bears", while young meeksi are small, bipedal humanoids. Despite their mischievous and playful nature, meeksi make for loyal and dependable traveling companions. Young meeksi have a penchant for finding both trouble and adventure. The Fullbelly meeksi will often put their own safety at risk if they smell food. Nothing brings them happiness like a cup of tea and a warm meal. The meeksi Teatuft Tamers love lounging with their teatufts and sipping a cup of mystical tea after a long, lazy day.

Memory of a Duke is a memory of Duke Hydraxis serving as a vendor at the Iron Summit in the Searing Gorge during the Radiant Echoes event.
